pergunta: Você pode listar todos os ministros brasileiros da Saúde desde o início de 2018 até o fim de 2024?
resposta:
Com base na lista oficial do Ministério da Saúde (Wikipedia e fontes corroborantes), aqui está a relação dos ministros que estiveram à frente da pasta no período de **1º de janeiro de 2018 a 31 de dezembro de 2024**:

---

## Ministros da Saúde do Brasil (2018–2024)

| # | Ministro(a) | Partido | Período | Presidente | Observações |
|---|------------|---------|---------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Ricardo Barros** | PP-PR | 01/01/2018 a 01/04/2018* | Michel Temer | Deixou o cargo para disputar eleição; foi o ministro desde maio de 2016 |
| 2 | **Gilberto Occhi** | PP | 02/04/2018 a 31/12/2018 | Michel Temer | Foi presidente da Caixa Econômica Federal quando assumiu |
| 3 | **Luiz Henrique Mandetta** | DEM→PSDB (?) | 01/01/2019 a 16/04/2020 | Jair Bolsonaro | Médico sanitarista; deixou o cargo durante a pandemia |
| 4 | **Nelson Teich** | Sem partido | 17/04/2020 a 15/05/2020 | Jair Bolsonaro | Médico cardiologista; apresentou pedido de demissão em apenas 29 dias |
| 5 | **Eduardo Pazuello** | PPL→Republicanos | 02/06/2020 a 23/03/2021* | Jair Bolsonaro | Assumiu **interinamente** em 02/06/2020 (como secretário-executivo) e foi efetivado como ministro em 16/09/2020 |
| 6 | **Marcelo Queiroga** | MDB | 23/03/2021 a 31/12/2022 | Jair Bolsonaro | Cardiologista; ficou menos de dois anos no cargo |
| 7 | **Nísia Trindade Lima** | PT | 01/01/2023 a 31/12/2024 | Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva | Primeira mulher a comandar o Ministério da Saúde; ex-presidente da Fiocruz |

\* *Datas aproximadas conforme registros oficiais.*

---

### Detalhamento importante:

- **Ricardo Barros** governou a pasta por mais de um ano e meio no total (desde maio de 2016), permanecendo no cargo até 1º de abril de 2018.
- Entre **15 e 30 de maio de 2020**, houve uma breve vacância após a saída de Nelson Teich, enquanto Pazuello ainda não estava formalmente no cargo.
- **Marcelo Queiroga** terminou seu mandato em 31/12/2022, já sob o governo Lula.
- **Nísia Trindade** comandou o Ministério ao longo de todo o ano de 2024 e só deixou o cargo em **10 de março de 2025**, quando foi substituída por Alexandre Padilha.

Esta é uma **lista de [ministros da Saúde do Brasil](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministério_da_Saúde_(Brasil) "Ministério da Saúde (Brasil)")**.[[1]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lista_de_ministros_da_Sa%C3%BAde_do_Brasil#cite_note-ms-1)

## Atual titular

O atual titular da pasta é [Alexandre Padilha](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alexandre_Padilha "Alexandre Padilha") ([PT](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Partido_dos_Trabalhadores "Partido dos Trabalhadores")-[SP](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/São_Paulo_(estado) "São Paulo (estado)")), [médico infectologista](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infectologia "Infectologia") pela [Universidade de São Paulo](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universidade_de_São_Paulo "Universidade de São Paulo"), PHD em Saúde Pública pela [UNICAMP](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universidade_Estadual_de_Campinas "Universidade Estadual de Campinas") e professor universitário, além de Deputado Federal licenciado por São Paulo, foi nomeado pelo atual presidente, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva em 10 de março de 2025.[[2]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lista_de_ministros_da_Sa%C3%BAde_do_Brasil#cite_note-2)[[3]](https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lista_de_ministros_da_Sa%C3%BAde_do_Brasil#cite_note-3)

International football competition

The **2023 Copa CONMEBOL Libertadores** was the 64th edition of the [CONMEBOL Libertadores](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_Libertadores "Copa Libertadores") (also referred to as the *Copa Libertadores*), [South America](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_America "South America")'s premier club [football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_football "Association football") tournament organized by [CONMEBOL](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CONMEBOL "CONMEBOL").

The [final](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_final "2023 Copa Libertadores final") was played at the [Estádio do Maracanã](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maracanã_Stadium "Maracanã Stadium") in [Rio de Janeiro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rio_de_Janeiro "Rio de Janeiro"), Brazil on 4 November 2023.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-1) Brazilian club [Fluminense](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluminense_FC "Fluminense FC") were the champions, winning their first Copa Libertadores title after defeating Argentine side [Boca Juniors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boca_Juniors "Boca Juniors") 2–1 [after extra time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overtime_(sports)#Association_football "Overtime (sports)") in the final.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-2) As winners of the 2023 Copa Libertadores, Fluminense earned the right to play against the winners of the [2023 Copa Sudamericana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Sudamericana "2023 Copa Sudamericana") in the [2024 Recopa Sudamericana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Recopa_Sudamericana "2024 Recopa Sudamericana"). They also automatically qualified for the [2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_FIFA_Club_World_Cup "2023 FIFA Club World Cup") and [2025 FIFA Club World Cups](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2025_FIFA_Club_World_Cup "2025 FIFA Club World Cup") and the [2024 Copa Libertadores](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_Copa_Libertadores "2024 Copa Libertadores") group stage.

[Flamengo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CR_Flamengo "CR Flamengo") were the defending champions, but were eliminated by [Olimpia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Club_Olimpia "Club Olimpia") in the round of 16.

## Teams

The following 47 teams from the 10 CONMEBOL member associations qualified for the tournament:[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3)

- Copa Libertadores champions
- Copa Sudamericana champions
- Brazil: 7 berths
- Argentina: 6 berths
- All other associations: 4 berths each

The entry stage was determined as follows:[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3)

- Group stage: 28 teams
  - Copa Libertadores champions
  - Copa Sudamericana champions
  - Teams which qualified for berths 1–5 from Argentina and Brazil
  - Teams which qualified for berths 1–2 from all other associations
- Second stage: 13 teams
  - Teams which qualified for berths 6–7 from Brazil
  - Team which qualified for berth 6 from Argentina
  - Teams which qualified for berths 3–4 from Chile and Colombia
  - Teams which qualified for berth 3 from all other associations
- First stage: 6 teams
  - Teams which qualified for berth 4 from Bolivia, Ecuador, Paraguay, Peru, Uruguay and Venezuela

The draw for the qualifying stages was held on 21 December 2022, 12:00 [PYST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_in_Paraguay "Time in Paraguay") ([UTC−3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC−03:00 "UTC−03:00")), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [Luque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luque "Luque"), [Paraguay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraguay "Paraguay").[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-20)

Teams were seeded by their *CONMEBOL Clubs ranking* as of 9 December 2022 (shown in parentheses),[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-ranking-21) taking into account the following three factors:[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-22)

1. Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2013–2022.
2. Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2012 and 2002–2012 respectively.
3. Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the first stage, the six teams were drawn into three ties (E1–E3), with the teams from Pot 1 hosting the second leg.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-draw_procedure-23)

The draw for the group stage was held on 27 March 2023, 20:00 [PYT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_in_Paraguay "Time in Paraguay") ([UTC−4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC−04:00 "UTC−04:00")), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [Luque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luque "Luque"), [Paraguay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraguay "Paraguay").[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-24)[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-25) For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The defending champions [Flamengo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CR_Flamengo "CR Flamengo") were directly assigned as the top seed of Group A (position A1). The remaining teams were distributed into four pots according to their CONMEBOL Clubs ranking. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group, excluding the four winners of the third stage, which were allocated to Pot 4 and could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

The draw for the round of 16 was held on 5 July 2023, 12:00 [PYT](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Time_in_Paraguay "Time in Paraguay") ([UTC−4](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UTC−04:00 "UTC−04:00")) at the CONMEBOL Convention Center in [Luque](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luque "Luque"), [Paraguay](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paraguay "Paraguay").[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-R16_draw-19)[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-26) For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3)

## Qualifying stages

Main article: [2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_qualifying_stages "2023 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages")

In the qualifying stages, each tie was played on a home-and-away [two-legged](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two-legged_tie "Two-legged tie") basis. If the teams had been tied on aggregate, [extra time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overtime_(sports)#Association_football "Overtime (sports)") would not have been played, and a [penalty shoot-out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penalty_shoot-out_(association_football) "Penalty shoot-out (association football)") would have been used to determine the winner (Regulations Article 2.4.3).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3) The qualifying stages were structured as follows:

- **First stage (6 teams):** The three winners of the first stage advanced to the second stage to join the 13 teams which were given byes to the second stage.
- **Second stage (16 teams):** The eight winners of the second stage advanced to the third stage.
- **Third stage (8 teams):** The four winners of the third stage advanced to the group stage to join the 28 direct entrants. The four teams eliminated in the third stage entered the [Copa Sudamericana group stage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Sudamericana_group_stage "2023 Copa Sudamericana group stage").

## Group stage

Main article: [2023 Copa Libertadores group stage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_group_stage "2023 Copa Libertadores group stage")

In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [round-robin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Round-robin_tournament "Round-robin tournament") basis. The teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [Points](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Points_(association_football) "Points (association football)") (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [Goal difference](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Goal_difference "Goal difference"); 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3)

The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [round of 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_final_stages#Round_of_16 "2023 Copa Libertadores final stages") of the [final stages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_final_stages "2023 Copa Libertadores final stages"). The third-placed teams of each group entered the [knockout round play-offs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Sudamericana_final_stages#Knockout_round_play-offs "2023 Copa Sudamericana final stages") of the [2023 Copa Sudamericana](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Sudamericana "2023 Copa Sudamericana").

## Final stages

Main article: [2023 Copa Libertadores final stages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores_final_stages "2023 Copa Libertadores final stages")

Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [single-elimination tournament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Single-elimination_tournament "Single-elimination tournament") with the following rules:[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2023_Copa_Libertadores#cite_note-regulations-3)

- In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [two-legged](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Two-legged_tie "Two-legged tie") basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 2.2.3.2). If tied on aggregate, [away goals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Away_goals_rule "Away goals rule") were not used, [extra time](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overtime_(sports)#Association_football "Overtime (sports)") was not played, and a [penalty shoot-out](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penalty_shoot-out_(association_football) "Penalty shoot-out (association football)") was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.3).
- The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 2.2.3.5). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of extra time were played. If still tied after extra time, a penalty shoot-out was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 2.4.4).

# 📜 Relatório Completo: Todas as Lembranças de Elden Ring (Jogo Base + DLC)

Em *Elden Ring*, as **Lembranças** (*Remembrances*) são itens especiais obtidos ao derrotar determinados chefes (Shardbearers). Elas podem ser usadas de duas formas principais:

1. **Trocar na Finger Reader Enia** (no Roundtable Hold) por armas, talismãs, incantações ou magia;
2. **Usar diretamente** para receber uma grande quantidade de runas (20.000 a 50.000).

No total existem **25 Lembranças**: 15 do jogo base + 10 adicionadas pelo DLC ***Shadow of the Erdtree***, além do bônus **Heart of Bayle**. Abaixo está a lista completa e detalhada.

## 🔄 Como Trocar as Lembranças

**No Jogo Base:**
- Leve sua Lembrança até **Enia (Finger Reader)** no **Roundtable Hold** e escolha "Power from Remembrance".
- Você escolhe entre a opção 1 ou 2 (ou usa a Lembrança diretamente para ganhar runas).
- Após escolher, a Lembrança é **perdida** até que seja **duplicada** num Mausoléu Errante.

**No DLC (Shadow of the Erdtree):**
- Mesmo sistema, mas agora também há os **Cofres de Duplicação de Lembranças** (localizados nos cemitérios da DLC) que permitem duplicar qualquer Lembrança (inclusive as do base game).

## 📝 Notas Importantes

1. **As Lembranças da Ranni e de Fia NÃO existem** como itens trocáveis no sistema oficial. Os itens dessas personagens são **recursos exclusivos de suas quests** (Dark Moon Greatsword, Carian Inverted Statue, Mending Rune of the Death-Prince, etc.), vendidos apenas pela própria NPC ou como parte da narrativa. Não há como trocá-los na Enia ou em outros comerciantes.

2. **Duplicação:** No jogo base, só dá para duplicar em **Mausoléus Errantes** (com sinos → qualquer Lembrança; sem sino → apenas Lembranças lendárias). No DLC, há **Cofres de Duplicação** que duplicam **qualquer** Lembrança. Cada duplicação consome uma Lembrança original (mas você mantém a original).

3. **Uma por troca:** Após escolher uma opção na Enia, a Lembrança fica **"consumida"** naquela forma até ser duplicada novamente. Você não pode reverter a troca.

4. **Poder Heroico vs. Runas:** Na Enia, cada Lembrança pode fornecer um **"poder heroico"** alternativo (arma/talismã exclusivo) em vez de runas. Porém, ao escolher o poder, a Lembrança se perde daquela configuração.

A malevolent snake writhed within Messmer, and so his very mother plucked out his eye and put in its place a seal of grace. Yet, having done so, her fear compelled her to secret away her child within the realm of shadow. Hidden away—keeping company with the original sin, and a hatred that would not be confined.

#### [remembrance of the full moon queen elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Full_Moon_Queen "Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen")  [Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Full_Moon_Queen "Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen")

Remembrance of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. In her youth, Rennala was prominent champion who charmed the academy with her lunar magic, becoming its master. She also led the Glintstone Knights and established the house of Caria as royalty.

#### [remembrance of the starscourge elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Starscourge "Remembrance of the Starscourge")  [Remembrance of the Starscourge](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Starscourge "Remembrance of the Starscourge")

Remembrance of Starscourge Radahn, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Red Lion General wielded gravitational powers which he learned in Sellia during his younger days. All so he would never have to abandon his beloved but scrawny steed.

#### [remembrance of the regal ancestor elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Regal_Ancestor "Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor")  [Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Regal_Ancestor "Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor")

Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor Spirit, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Ancestral spirits exist as a phenomenon beyond the purview of the Erdtree. Life sprouts from death, as it does from birth. Such is the way of the living.

#### [remembrance of the omen king elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Omen_King "Remembrance of the Omen King")  [Remembrance of the Omen King](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Omen_King "Remembrance of the Omen King")

Remembrance of Morgott, the Omen King, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Though born one of the graceless Omen, Morgott took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector. He loved not in return, for he was never loved, but nevertheless, love it he did.

#### [remembrance of the naturalborn elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Naturalborn "Remembrance of the Naturalborn")  [Remembrance of the Naturalborn](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Naturalborn "Remembrance of the Naturalborn")

Remembrance of Astel, Naturalborn of the Void, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. A malformed star born in the flightless void far away. Once destroyed an Eternal City and took away their sky. An falling star of ill omen.

#### [remembrance of the blasphemous elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blasphemous "Remembrance of the Blasphemous")  [Remembrance of the Blasphemous](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blasphemous "Remembrance of the Blasphemous")

Remembrance of of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Rykard took the form of a giant serpent that he might devour, grow, and live eternally.  
"I understand. The road of blasphemy is long and perilous. One cannot walk it unprepared to sin."

#### [remembrance of the lichdragon elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lichdragon "Remembrance of the Lichdragon")  [Remembrance of the Lichdragon](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Lichdragon "Remembrance of the Lichdragon")

Remembrance of Lichdragon Fortissax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. After Godwyn the Golden became the Prince of Death, the ancient dragon fought long and hard against the Death within its companion. Alas, victory was never achieved and its only reward was corruption.

#### [remembrance of the fire giant elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Fire_Giant "Remembrance of the Fire Giant")  [Remembrance of the Fire Giant](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Fire_Giant "Remembrance of the Fire Giant")

Remembrance of Fire Giant, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Fire Giant is a survivor of the War against the Giants. Upon realizing the flames of their forge would never die, Queen Marika marked him with a curse.  
"O trifling giant, mayest thou tend thy flame for eternity."

#### [remembrance of the blood lord item elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blood_Lord "Remembrance of the Blood Lord")  [Remembrance of the Blood Lord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Blood_Lord "Remembrance of the Blood Lord")

Remembrance of Mohg, Lord of Blood, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Wishing to raise Miquella to full godhood, Mohg wished to become his consort, taking the role of monarch. But no matter how much of his bloody bedchamber he tried to share, he received no response from the young Empyrean.

#### [remembrance of the black blade elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Black_Blade "Remembrance of the Black Blade")  [Remembrance of the Black Blade](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Black_Blade "Remembrance of the Black Blade")

Remembrance of Maliketh, the Black Blade, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Maliketh was a shadowbound beast given to his Empyrean. Marika's sole need of her shadow was a vessel to lock away Destined Death. Even then, she betrayed him.

#### [remembrance of the dragonlord item elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dragonlord "Remembrance of the Dragonlord")  [Remembrance of the Dragonlord](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Dragonlord "Remembrance of the Dragonlord")

Remembrance of Dragonlord Placidusax, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. The Dragonlord whose seat lies at the heart of the storm beyond time is said to have been Elden Lord in the age before the Erdtree. Once his god was fled, the lord continued to await its return.

#### [remembrance of hoarah loux elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Hoarah_Loux "Remembrance of Hoarah Loux")  [Remembrance of Hoarah Loux](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_Hoarah_Loux "Remembrance of Hoarah Loux")

Remembrance of the warrior Hoarah Loux, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. When Godfrey, first Elden Lord was robbed of his grace, becoming Tarnished, he took with him his kinfolk and left the Lands Between. After the Long March of the Tarnished came to an end, Godfrey divested himself of kingship, becoming a simple warrior once more.

#### [remembrance of the rot goddess elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Rot_Goddess "Remembrance of the Rot Goddess")  [Remembrance of the Rot Goddess](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_of_the_Rot_Goddess "Remembrance of the Rot Goddess")

Remembrance of Malenia, Goddess of Rot, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. Miquella and Malenia are both the children of a single god. As such they are both Empyreans, but suffered afflictions from birth. One was cursed with eternal childhood, and the other harbored rot within.

#### [elden remembrance elden ring wiki guide 200px](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Remembrance "Elden Remembrance")  [Elden Remembrance](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Remembrance "Elden Remembrance")

Remembrance of the Elden Beast, hewn into the Erdtree. The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader. Alternatively, it can be used to gain a great bounty of runes. It was the vassal beast of the Greater Will and living incarnation of the concept of Order.

## Remembrance Duplication[]

[Wandering Mausoleums](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Wandering_Mausoleum "Wandering Mausoleum") and [Remembrance Coffins](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Remembrance_Coffin "Remembrance Coffin") can be used once each to duplicate a Remembrance, even if the Remembrance has already been used. Mausoleums with bells can duplicate any remembrance, but the two mausoleums without bells at the [![Sites of Grace](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/ER_Map_Icon_Site_of_Grace.png)](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Sites_of_Grace "Sites of Grace") Mausoleum Compound site of grace can only duplicate a Legend remembrance. Coffins found in the [Shadow of the Erdtree expansion](https://eldenring.fandom.com/wiki/Elden_Ring:_Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree") can duplicate any remembrance.

**Enia** or **Finger Reader Enia** is an [NPC](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/NPCs "NPCs") in [Elden Ring](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Wiki "Elden Ring Wiki"). **Enia** is an ancient woman, wielding a massive club. She is known as the *Finger Reader*. **Enia** can help the player draw out the power that lies within a remembrance of a powerful deity. Enia is different from the nameless [Finger Readers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Palm_Reader "Palm Reader") that you meet in different areas, Enia seems to know you, but for the Finger Readers, their interests pique as they try to read what is written on your fingers. Enia also serves as a direct interpreter of the [Two Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Two_Fingers "Two Fingers"), envoys to [The Greater Will](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/The_Greater_Will "The Greater Will").

- [Champion and Boss Equipment](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaEquipment)
- [Remembrance Transformation](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaRemembranceShop)
- [Enia's Dialogue](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaDialogue)
- [Enia Lore](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#lore)

> The Fingers guide us all. And you Tarnished, you are here to take, are you not?

### Enia Location in Elden Ring

Enia can be found at [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold") as a merchant. She will be in the room with the Two Fingers, which can be accessed after defeating a Shardbearer.

- This NPC does not move.
- This merchant can't be fought.

### Enia Shop: Power from Remembrance in Elden Ring[§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaRemembranceShop)

You can draw out heroic powers from memories, known as [Remembrances](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrances "Remembrances"). Note that each memory can provide one power. Once that power is claimed, the memory is lost. Note that Remembrances can be duplicated at a [Walking Mausoleum](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Walking_Mausoleum "Walking Mausoleum"). Only one remembrance may be duplicated per mausoleum, and only one time. Using this method makes it possible to obtain both powers from the same remembrance, in the same playthrough. You cannot obtain two copies of a power in the same playthrough.

- [Shadow of the Erdtree](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Shadow of the Erdtree") added [Remembrance Duplication Coffins](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Remembrance_Duplication_Coffin "Remembrance Duplication Coffin") which function the same as the Mausoleums, they fulfill the same role, but unlike their base game counterpart, they are not guarded nor do they move in place.

### Enia's Dialogue in Elden Ring[§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaDialogue)

### [§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaIntroduction)Introduction

Enia:

*Are you the new Tarnished? You've done well. I am Enia, the Finger Reader.*

*I interpret the words of the Fingers, envoys to the Greater Will.*

*Look there. The Fingers tremble. To welcome you, shardbearer. Let their wisdom wash over you.*

[Two Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Two_Fingers "Two Fingers"):

*Great Elden Ring,* *root of the Golden Order.* *Anchor of all lands,* *giver of grace,* *wellspring of all joy. '**Until it was shattered.***

*The tragic corruption of the Order has taken its toll.* *Across the realm, life lies in ruin.* *Fallen to pieces. '**Foul curses and misery spread, unabating.***

*But the Greater Will has not abandoned the realm,* *nor the life that inhabits it.*  
*So it is that the Tarnished are guided by grace.* *Called to act.*

*Brave Tarnished,* *your Great Rune is a handsome shard of the Elden Ring.*  
*Seek another of its kind.* *To become Elden Lord,* *and restore the Golden Order.*

Enia:

*Let the words of the Fingers guide you.*

Enia*:*

*Well, well...I see...*  *A remembrance of gold has found its way into your possession.*

*Demigods, and even the greater of the champions,*  *are hewn by the Erdtree upon their end, into remembrances.*

*They are...valuable indeed.*

*These remembrances yet house the power of their former masters.*  *And should you wish to wield that same power,*  *well... I will lend you the strength of the Fingers.*

*Heh... Do not recoil from my offer.*  *The Fingers guide us all.*

*And you Tarnished, you are here to take, are you not?*

Enia:

*Ahh, Great Runes are the stuff of demigods: the children of the goddess, Queen Marika. '**She who is vessel of the Elden Ring. '''***

*Tainted by the strength of their runes, '''***her children warred, '**but none could become Elden Lord. '''

***'''***

And so grace was extended, '''***to your kind, the Tarnished

Listen, the Fingers speak.***

[Two Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Two_Fingers "Two Fingers")*:*

*The Greater Will has long renounced the demigods.*

*Tarnished, show no mercy. Have their heads. Take all they have left.*

Enia*:*

*...Indeed.*

*But remember one thing. The demigods are each and all the direct offspring of Queen Marika.*

*Godrick the Grafted was but a distant relation... The runt of the litter, his divine blood sorely diluted.*

Enia:

*Queen Marika is the vessel of the Elden Ring, carrier of its vision.* *A god, in truth.*

*But after the Elden Ring's shattering,* *she was imprisoned in the Erdtree.*

*A grim punishment for shattering the Order,* *despite her godhood.*

*The Fingers speak...*

[Two Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Two_Fingers "Two Fingers"):

*Marika's trespass demanded a heavy sentence.   But even in shackles, she remains a god, and the vision's vessel.*

*Confer Great Runes to become Elden Lord, and join Queen Marika as her consort.*

*The Fingers have willed it so.*

Enia:

*Now, you may go.*

Enia:

*I had my doubts, '**but...my, look at you.*** ***Only once before have I seen two Great Runes together.***

***Look there. The Fingers shudder with exuberance.***

[Two Fingers](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Two_Fingers "Two Fingers")*:*

*Fine work, brave Tarnished. The Greater Will is pleased.  
You have earned the right to become Elden Lord.*

*Now, seek the Erdtree, and an audience with Queen Marika.  
To become Elden Lord, and restore the Golden Order.*

Enia*:*

*The Fingers expect... As much from you as they do young Gideon.*

*Take this. A token of farewell.*

[[[Talisman Pouch]]]

Enia:

*Well, you managed to return.* *You know what this means.* *The Erdtree has spurned you.*

*The Fingers remain still.* *Shaken by this turn of events,* *they are busy consulting the Greater Will.*  *When they are finished,* *the Fingers will once again offer their guidance.*

*But thousands, if not tens of thousands, of moons must first pass.  
No matter for me.  
But you? How will you ever manage the wait...  
My, oh, my...*

Enia:

*Heavens forbid... '**That is not the domain of mere men.***

***The burning of the Erdtree is the first cardinal sin.*  
*And you say you seek the power of the Rune of Death, too?***

*The Rune of Death goes by two names; the other is Destined Death.  
The forbidden shadow, plucked from the Golden Order upon its creation...*

*Unleashing the rune now would be unthinkable...  
The Fingers would never permit it. Nor would the Greater Will.*

*... But here we are...  
The Fingers, dormant, severing our link to the Greater Will.  
The realm, and all life, in ruins.  
Impossible events transpire, beyond the ken of the Fingers.*

*Who is to say that the cardinal sin must be cardinal forever?*

*Go on. Finish the job. Take the course you deem most worthy.*

Enia:

*You must find kindling.*   *Only the smoldering flame in the Great Forge of the Giants,* *on the highest peak in the Lands Between,* *can burn the Erdtree.*

*But special kindling is required to reignite the flame.  
For the flame to burn the Erdtree, a sacrifice is needed.  
Of one who envisions the flame.  
And can lead you to the Rune of Death.*

### [§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#AfterBurningGoldTree)After burning Erdtree

Enia:

*You've done it, I see.**What use do you have for me, now?* *I am a Finger Reader.  
I will remain here, until their dialogue ends, and the Fingers speak again.*  

*Do as you please. Take whatever course seems most worthy to you.*  

*Now, you may go.*

Enia - 2nd time speaking to her:

*Heh, heh, heh.*  *You'd force this tired old crone to work, even now?*  *A harder taskmaster I have never met.*

Enia *- 3rd time speaking to her, after reloading area:*

*Don't worry, my dear.  
I'll see it to the end with you, if it please.*

Enia - Upon leaving:

*Now, go forth.  
Let the words of the Fingers guide you*

Enia *- Upon leaving, after visiting [Crumbling Farum Azula](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Crumbling_Farum_Azula "Crumbling Farum Azula"):*

*Now, go forth.  
Do what you believe is right.*

(After defeating [Maliketh](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Maliketh,_the_Black_Blade "Maliketh, the Black Blade")... and releasing [Destined Death](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/file/Elden-Ring/rune-of-death-cinematic-lore-boss-elden-ring-wiki-guide.jpg)... from the cutscene)

Enia*:*

*The Rune of Death is unbound,* *and the Lands Between are shrouded by Death's dark fate.**But the flames will also burn the impenetrable thorns.*  *Farewell it is, then.*  *You'll be Elden Lord yet.*

Past this point, Enia will no longer have any further dialogue at the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold"); nor elsewhere.  

However, she will continue to transform [remembrances](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaRemembranceShop) and sell [boss armors](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Enia#EniaEquipment).

### Enia Lore

#### [Talisman Pouch](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Talisman_Pouch "Talisman Pouch")

*Small, withered bag, knitted by hand. Bestowed upon the ruling lord, or those attempting to become lord, by the elderly Finger Reader.*

*Increases talisman equip slots.*

*As the voices of the Two Fingers, Finger Readers are said to live lives eternal, and one is even supposed to have served as a wetnurse to royalty.*

#### [Cipher Pata](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Cipher_Pata "Cipher Pata")

*One of the weapons originating from the Two Fingers.*

*A formless sequence of ciphers comprise its blade, and as such no shield can repel it. Deals holy damage.*

*The furtive inscription appears to hang in the air; the language of light spoken by the Two Fingers.*

#### [Coded Sword](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Coded_Sword "Coded Sword")

*Hidden sword once granted to the Tarnished of the Roundtable by the Two Fingers. A formless cipher comprises its blade, which deals holy damage no shield can repel.*

*Champions would gather at the Roundtable Hold in days long past, when the Two Fingers were masters of oration, their flesh yet full of vigor.*

## Fia | Elden Ring Wiki

This page was last edited on 14 August 2026, at 14:58.

From Elden Ring Wiki

**Fia** is a [Tarnished](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Tarnished "Tarnished") [NPC](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/NPCs "NPCs") in [Elden Ring](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Elden_Ring_Wiki "Elden Ring Wiki"). **Fia** is a deathbed companion that you will find inside a small bedroom at the Roundtable Hold. Her embrace will give you a special consumable that can increase poise called the [Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Baldachin's Blessing"), at the cost of a [debuff](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Buffs_and_Debuffs "Buffs and Debuffs") that slightly decreases your maximum [HP](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/HP "HP"). You can ostensibly come back for more if you happen to run out of this consumable. [Fia's Questline Steps](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia#questline) are highlighted below.

[See Fia, Deathbed Companion Lore](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia#lore)
> Greetings, great champion called by grace. I am Fia. Circumstances have compelled my stay at the Roundtable Hold.

### Fia, Deathbed Companion Location in Elden Ring

Fia can be found at the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold") and later again after defeating [Fia's champions](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_champions "Fia's champions") in [Deeproot Depths](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Deeproot_Depths "Deeproot Depths").

- This NPC moves.
- This NPC can be fought and killed, but only in a later stage of her questline.
  - If killed, drops:  
[Fia's Hood](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_Hood "Fia's Hood")  
[Fia's Robe](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_Robe "Fia's Robe")
- Grants [Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Baldachin's Blessing") if you allow her to hold you. Decreases your max. HP by 5% for as long as you keep it in your inventory. After consuming it and its effect ending, you will regain your full HP.  
  - She grants you **Baldachin's Blessing** infinitely as long as you don't have one currently in your inventory.

### Fia Questline: How to complete Fia, Deathbed Companion's Quest

Note: The beginning of **Fia’s questline** is skipped after gaining access to [Crumbling Farum Azula](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Crumbling_Farum_Azula "Crumbling Farum Azula")

- After starting the festival at Redmane Castle to fight [Starscourge Radahn](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Starscourge_Radahn "Starscourge Radahn"), you can return to Fia and embrace her. She will gain an additional line of dialogue during which she will hand you a [Weathered Dagger](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Weathered_Dagger "Weathered Dagger"). Take this dagger to [D, Hunter of the Dead](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/D,_Hunter_of_the_Dead "D, Hunter of the Dead") at the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold") to progress the quest.
- Talk to [Sorcerer Rogier](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Sorcerer_Rogier "Sorcerer Rogier") about his interest in the Black Knives, then speak to Fia again. She will give you a [Knifeprint Clue](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Knifeprint_Clue "Knifeprint Clue") that reveals the location of a [Black Knifeprint](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Black_Knifeprint "Black Knifeprint").
- After this, reload the area. You will find Fia in a newly opened room near the blacksmith, but then she will disappear.
- Make your way to the **Across the Roots** Site of Grace [Map Link](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Interactive_Map?mapId=vm6a67bad89240c157fd42bcf2&markerId=5362#tabber-Underground_Map "Interactive Map") in [Deeproot Depths](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Deeproot_Depths "Deeproot Depths") and enter the boss arena to the north. After defeating [Fia's champions](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_champions "Fia's champions"), you will find her seated at the back of the arena. Speak with her and choose to be hugged to advance her quest. She will then ask you to bring her the [Cursemark of Death](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Cursemark_of_Death "Cursemark of Death"), a key item from [Ranni's](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Ranni "Ranni") questline. If Fia is not present and has already killed [D](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/D,_Hunter_of_the_Dead "D, Hunter of the Dead") and has vanished from [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold"), you may need to take extra steps to make her appear. Defeat the [Valiant Gargoyles](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Valiant_Gargoyle "Valiant Gargoyle") and rest in the coffin in their boss arena to reach Deeproot Depths. Fia may appear after taking the coffin route to Deeproot Depths. Alternatively, you can access Deeproot Depths by revealing two illusory walls south of the **Frenzied Flame Proscription** Site of Grace [Map Link](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Interactive_Map?mapId=vm6a67b6fa9240c157fd42bc83&markerId=5968#tabber-Overland_Map "Interactive Map").  
  - **Note that a big chunk of her questline can be skipped, if one so desires (main Quest spoilers ahead!):**  
Once the player progressed through the main events of the game up to the point of burning the Erdtree, Fia will relocate to the [Deeproot Depths](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Deeproot_Depths "Deeproot Depths") even if the player never interacted with her. This way, all of the steps mentioned above are skipped. [Elden Ring Map Link](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Interactive_Map?mapId=vm6a67bad89240c157fd42bcf2&markerId=9021#tabber-Underground_Map "Interactive Map")
    - The arena is large. Run up to the way gate in the northeast of the area, which is currently disabled, to trigger the fight.
    - You will then be allowed to summon your spirit ash
    - [Fia's champions](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_champions "Fia's champions") will spawn.
  - If the player chooses to use this method, they will still find [D, Hunter of the Dead](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/D,_Hunter_of_the_Dead "D, Hunter of the Dead")'s corpse on the ground where he is normally found (at Roundtable Hold, down the hall from Hewg), but Fia will not stand above it and then vanish since she already left the [Roundtable Hold](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Roundtable_Hold "Roundtable Hold").
- Bringing back the Cursemark of Death will nearly end her quest. After you give it to her, she will give the player a [Radiant Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Radiant_Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Radiant Baldachin's Blessing"). Exhaust her dialog and upon reloading the area, she'll be asleep. Inspecting her will let you enter the Deathbed Dream to fight [Lichdragon Fortissax](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Lichdragon_Fortissax "Lichdragon Fortissax").
- Winning this fight will allow you to pick up the [Mending Rune of the Death-Prince](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Mending_Rune_of_the_Death-Prince "Mending Rune of the Death-Prince") from Fia, which will in turn allow you to obtain an alternate [ending](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Endings "Endings").
- After acquiring the rune, you can give the Twinned armor set to D's brother (NPC sitting on the floor past the corridor to the southeast of the [Valiant Gargoyle](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Valiant_Gargoyle "Valiant Gargoyle") boss' grace site "Great Waterfall Basin"). Upon returning to Fia, you will find [Fia's Set](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_Set "Fia's Set") next to her, and if you reload the area, D's brother will leave behind the [Twinned Set](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Twinned_Set "Twinned Set") you gave him, as well as the [Inseparable Sword](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Inseparable_Sword "Inseparable Sword"). Killing D's brother will also get you the armor set and the sword.
- You can prevent this scene by killing D in his first location, getting his armor, and giving it to his brother early. After reloading the area he can be fought.

### Dialogue in Elden Ring: Fia

Introduction

- *Greetings, great champion called by grace. '**I am Fia.'''***  
*Circumstances have compelled my stay at the Roundtable Hold.*  
*Great champion, would you allow me to hold you, but briefly?*  
*Perhaps you might share with me some of your lifely vigour, and your stout-heartedness.*  
*Doing so will grant me the warmth of a champion. '''***And you, I am sure, will bear a baldachin's blessing.Do you think it vulgar, perhaps? '**Where I come from, it is a sacred act.

Letting her hold you

- *"Ah, my thanks, great champion. '**You are...very warm..."  
'''*****[Player obtains Baldachin's Blessing]**  
*"What you felt light up inside you was a baldachin's blessing. '''***Though it is but a fleeting thing, I am afraid.Come back to me, should you require another. '**I will take you in my arms as often as you need".

Talk in secret

- *I was known as a Deathbed Companion, where I come from.  
After I received the warmth and lifely vigour from a number of champions,*  
*I lay with the remains of an exalted noble, to grant him another chance at life. To do so is the purpose of my being.*  
*But before I could bear the noble into new life, I was awakened by the guidance of grace, and chased from my birthplace.*  
*Pray, be kind. Despite all that, I still wish to be Deathbed Companion.*  
*So please, let me hold you like this, as often as it takes.*

About the Black Knifeprint (Do you know...?)

- *My dear... Have you ever heard of black knifeprints? Dear Rogier likes to talk of it when abed.*  
*The ancient plot, in which the first of the Demigods was slain. The black knifes wielded by the assassins who committed the act,*  
*along with the impressions they made, somehow hide the truth of the conspiracy. These grand affairs are hardly my forté...*  
*But dear Rogier began to weep as he spoke...*
- *In truth I've heard tell from someone else, about the black knifeprints that fascinate dear Rogier so.*  
*(receives: [Knifeprint Clue](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Knifeprint_Clue "Knifeprint Clue"))*  
*But It wouldn't be right to give this to him, stuck as he is in the Roundtable Hold.*  
*Perhaps you could make use of it?*

About Rogier

- *I heard that you lent a hand to dear Rogier. He seemed positively elated.*  
*He must be possessed of great mental fortitude. It anchors his will, and sustains him, despite his grievous wounds.*  
*You truly are a champion. To dear Rogier, and myself, too.*  
(receive: [Sacrificial Twig](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Sacrificial_Twig "Sacrificial Twig") x1)

Other

- (May I ask a favor?) "*My dear? Might I ask something of you? Could you please find the owner of this dagger, and return it to them?"* [Receive [Weathered Dagger](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Weathered_Dagger "Weathered Dagger")] "*A certain person gave it to me as a gift. It's a very precious thing. It must have a special place in the owner's heart. So I would like for the owner to have it back, if you wouldn't mind."*
- (Upon D's death) "*Finally, it is returned to its rightful place. The stolen hallowbrand, of the exalted noble. And now, I must bid you goodbye as well. Though I ask you deliver this message to the Roundtable Hold. I am Fia, Deathbed Companion. Hark, Roundtable. Disturb not the Death of Godwyn, the exalted. We, who humbly live in Death...Live in waiting, to one day welcome our Lord. What right does anyone have to object? Our Lord will rise. The Lord of the many, and the meek."*

At Deeproot Depths after defeating her champions.

- *"Ah...there you are.*  
*I knew you would come.*  
*What is it you intend?*  
*To deny us, and our ways?*  
*Like the dogmatic brutes of the Golden Order?"*
- (Answering her "That's Right")  
*"I see. Then you must kill me.  
For I am the companion of Godwyn, Prince of Death.'**I wished to be a mother to Those Who Live in Death.  
So it is, that any loathing, any hatred that overshadows them...  
I must bear, as a matter of duty, with my own flesh.***  
**(You can talk to her again to get the chance to change your choice)  
*"Go on, kill me.  
You deny us, do you not?  
Because we deign to live in Death, and wish our Lord to rise to glory.***  
- (Answering "No, I want to be held")  
*"You are an odd one.  
I am the guardian of Those Who Live in Death.  
They call me a foul and rotten witch.  
Yet you still wish to be held by me?"*  
Proceeds to hug her.
- Talk in Secret 1  
*"Have you ever seen a hallowbrand?  
When the first of the demigods died, his flesh was marked with the half-wheel wound of the centipede.  
Godwyn's hallowbrand has since been recovered at the Roundtable Hold.  
But there is another hallowbrand out there somewhere.  
And I must find it.  
Before the time comes we receive our Lord."*
- Talk in Secret 2  
*"When Godwyn died, a hallowbrand scored his flesh.  
But another exists. Another mark in the shape of the half-wheel wound of the centipede.  
And I must find it.  
Before the time comes we receive our Lord.  
My hands will be dirtied once more by the deed.  
Will you still let me hold you, even then?"*  
Gives you the choice to "Give Cursemark of Death".
- [§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia#DeeprootGiveCursemark)Give Cursemark of Death:  
*"This...is the other hallowbrand.  
How did you...  
Oh, my utmost thanks.  
With this, Godwyn can take his rightful place as First of the Dead.  
And claim a second, illustrious life.  
You are my-- our true champion.  
And though I can't be of any use to you...  
Can I hold you tight, if only for a moment?"'***Holds tighter.  
Grants [Radiant Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Radiant_Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Radiant Baldachin's Blessing").**
- Talk in Secret 3  
*"I will soon lay with Godwyn.  
And it will surely stir within me.  
The new life of the golden prince, and first Dead of the demigods,  
as the rune of Those Who Live in Death.  
Please, do one thing for me.'**Brandish this child, my rune, and take for yourself the throne.  
Stay the persecution of Those Who Live in Death.  
By becoming our Elden Lord."***
- Talk in Secret 4  
*"I will soon lay with Godwyn.  
To conceive my child, the rune.  
Brandish my rune, and take for yourself the throne.  
Stay the persecution of Those Who Live in Death.  
By becoming our Elden Lord."*
- [§](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia#DeeprootSecret5)Talk in Secret 5 (Being held after reloading, before she sleeps)  
*"This is goodbye, my dear.*  
*But I am satisfied.*  
*I choose to lie with Godwyn of my own will. Not the remains of one chosen for me.*  
*And I will bear a child.  
Who will inherit your warmth, too.  
What greater blessing could there be, but to be born a Deathbed Companion?"*

When attacked

- *Godwyn... Is that you, dear?*

Upon defeat

- *Will your kind never stop? Ravaging... the weak?*

### Elden Ring Fia, Deathbed Companion Notes & Trivia

- Fia's name in earlier versions of the game was “Lady Yuliya.”

- You can find Lionel's desiccated corpse on a bed in Leyndell alongside Fia's dress

- Receiving Fia's embrace will result in a **debuff** that lowers 5% of total vitality but can be removed from using [Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Baldachin's Blessing").

- Allowing Fia to grant her blessing will trigger an animation where she will embrace the Tarnished.     [![fia hold](https://static0.fextralifeimages.com/file/eldenring/thumb/7/75/Fia_hold.png/315px-Fia_hold.png)](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/File:Fia_hold.png)  
*[Fia holding the Tarnished close when offering her blessing.]*

- Receiving Fia's embrace while playing online will result in the player's [build](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Builds "Builds") being uploaded to the Elden Ring server to be used as one of the randomized [Fia's champions](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_champions "Fia's champions").

### Fia Lore

[https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/clo-qdyYIZ8?](https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/clo-qdyYIZ8?)

#### [Weathered Dagger](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Weathered_Dagger "Weathered Dagger")

*Dagger received from Fia, the Deathbed Companion.*

*She wishes for it to be returned to its rightful owner.*

*It was once a special weapon of gold and silver intertwined, but is now worn down and marred by a black gash.*

#### [Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Baldachin's Blessing")

*Favor bestowed by a deathbed companion. Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber.*

*Uses FP to temporarily boost poise.*

*The favor allows one to forget any aches and pains. In Death, there is only peace, for in Death, there can be no sensation.*

#### [Radiant Baldachin's Blessing](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Radiant_Baldachin%27s_Blessing "Radiant Baldachin's Blessing")

*Protection of a hidden temple in the guise of a bedchamber. This blessing is of the utmost rarity.*

*Uses FP to temporarily raise poise. The effect lasts longer than a mere favor.*

*It's said a deathbed companion will only produce a blessing of this kind for a champion but once in her entire life. The sole blessing which she imbues of her own volition.*

#### [Fia's Mist](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Fia%27s_Mist "Fia's Mist")

*Sorcery of Fia, the Deathbed Companion.*

*Creates a deathly mist before the caster, which inflicts Death blight upon those who enter. '**This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances range of the mist.***

*This sorcery was developed to oppose the Roundtable Hold, and is effective only against the Tarnished.*

#### [Lionel's Armor](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Lionel%27s_Armor "Lionel's Armor")

*Round iron armor with a banner extending from its back. Worn by the Lionel the Lionhearted.*

*When this chivalrous dauntless knight met Fia, who had been driven from her home, he declared himself to be her father.*

#### [Mending Rune of the Death-Prince](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Mending_Rune_of_the_Death-Prince "Mending Rune of the Death-Prince")

*Rune gestated by Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord.*

*Formed of the two hallowbrand half-wheels combined, it will embed the principle of life within Death into Order.*

*The Golden Order was created by confining Destined Death. Thus, this new Order will be one of Death restored.*

#### [D, Hunter of the Dead](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/D,_Hunter_of_the_Dead "D, Hunter of the Dead")

*I have a matter of my own to attend to. I spotted the mark of the centipede here in the village. An ill-omened symbol that should not be. Someone, or something, threatens the sanctity of the Golden Order. And must be eradicated.*

*I serve the Golden Order. That I might put this crooked land to rights. Following only the guidance of the great Elden Ring. Those Who Live in Death fall outside the principles of the Golden Order. Their mere existence sullies the guidance of gold. Tainting its truth. And so it is the vermin must be exterminated... Down to the very last.*

*Well, what have we here? How did you get your hands on that dagger? ...Well. That hardly matters. I know very well whose dagger it is. Why don't I return it to them for you? Good work, bringing this to me.*

#### [Sorcerer Rogier](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Sorcerer_Rogier "Sorcerer Rogier")

*I'm afraid there's something I must tell you. '**Do you know of Those Who Live in Death? '**The very notion of life in death defies the Golden Order. '**By D's account, these defiled fiends must be expunged. '**But truth be told, I seek the cursemark to save them. '**You may find this peculiar, '**but I discovered something in my examination of the Night of the Black Knives. '**These souls have committed no offence. They have every right to life, only, they happened to touch upon a flaw in the Order.***

*Hmm. Maybe I should tell you. Lately, I feel I'm on the precipice... Of falling into a deep...fathomless slumber. And I have an inkling it could spell trouble for you, somehow. So I just wanted to get the apology out of the way, beforehand.*

#### [D, Beholder of Death](https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/D,_Beholder_of_Death "D, Beholder of Death")

*You will know vengeance for Darian. '**The wrath of D...***

*Ah. Hello. '**The rotten witch is dead. The Golden Order, unsullied. '**Now I can look my brother Darian in the eye. '**Honeyed rays of gold, deliver my spirit.***

*Darian, now I have no regrets. '**Honeyed rays of gold, deliver my spirit.***

*Very well. Then you are a blight. A defiler of the Golden Order, and murderer of my brother. Die! Die! Die! I'll grind your corpse into that vile wench's rotting remains. A witch's eternal embrace, just as you wished!*
